Notes_and_Tips: Keep rice portions controlled to support PCOS and fat loss.
For sweet cravings, start meals with protein and eat slowly.
Avoid frequent fried foods; use pan fried or pressure cooked methods.
Social gatherings can trigger overeating; eat a protein-based meal beforehand.
Regular yoga and meal timing help hormonal balance and mental wellbeing.
Consistency with simple meals is more important than perfection.
